Major rehab tentatively planned for 2026; completion not confirmed in the sources read

corrections.why: The association's page labels the Forest Service file for this pre-project assessment as 2023, although its text says 'this year's'. The 2026 date may be the year of the planned rehab from the 2024 newsletter rather than of the assessment.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, FireLookout.com and the association's 2026 page give 1926. The 2024 newsletter says the cabin kit was packed in fall 1926 and construction was finished in spring 1927 after snow. The story uses 1926 and notes the spring 1927 finish.

notes_for_editor: Elevation (2,219 m, 7,281 ft) and coordinates match the NHLR page; no elevation key is in the research schema. The record's 'D-6' designation was not found in any page read, so design uses cupola-style wording only. The record's 2023 'in disrepair... common shelter for Continental Divide hikers' note was not found; the association's pages place the lookout near the Pacific Northwest Trail, so the Continental Divide wording was left out. The pre-project assessment year is disputed (see corrections). The 2024 major rehab is listed as tentatively planned for 2026; its status was not confirmed, so check before publishing. The 2024 newsletter is a PDF whose text is column-laid; quotes were taken from the cached text.
